The examples in `gfm-0.29-extensions.json` are adapted from the
[GitHub Flavored Markdown Specification, version 0.29](https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/master/test/spec.txt),
copyright GitHub, Inc., licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

The fixture retains the Markdown examples and converts the specification's
rendered HTML expectations into semantic node counts. The raw-HTML tag-filter
example is listed separately because W.mdx handles raw HTML under its no-HTML
compatibility policy.
